title: feat(java): Add Auto Refresh
description: Adds ElastiCacheIamAuthTokenManager: lazy token caching, background refresh, a single shared mint across concurrent callers, retry with jittered backoff while serving a valid token, token-change callbacks, and close semantics.

acceptance_criteria.text: Concurrent callers share one in-flight token mint.
A cached token is served only while it is valid for use, and refresh failures retry with backoff.
Every failure, including Errors, completes shared refresh state so later requests can recover.
close() stops refresh and no token is published after close.

defects.summary: Callbacks run on the shared commonPool and the executor is not configurable, so a slow onTokenChanged can starve the application's common pool.
